candidate.answerReason: Parallel lines cut by a transversal have equal alternate interior angles, so B is always correct. The other relationships are not generally true.

methods.label: Properties of parallel lines
methods.explanation: When two lines are parallel, corresponding angles are equal, alternate interior angles are equal, and same-side interior angles are supplementary.
methods.levelReason: Directly recalls the Grade 7 angle properties of parallel lines.
